faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support III posts is 03 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Technical Support III at AIIMS Delhi?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Project Technical Support III position at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Graduate degree in psychology/public health/social work/sociology/nursing with three years of experience, or a Post-graduate degree in the same fields.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support III role?
faq.answer: The age limit for this position is between 18 years and 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support III position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 36400 Per Month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the notification, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online. Candidates must submit their applications through the official website or the provided link.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job type for the Project Technical Support III position is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF and the online application link are provided in the Important Links section of this article for your convenience.
